name: VIX calm-regime momentum — trade crypto trend only when equity vol is quiet (long spot)
rationale: REGIME-SWITCHING cross-market gate (vix_level x crypto momentum). Crypto carries a high beta to broad-equity risk appetite, and equity-implied volatility (VIX) is the canonical risk-regime switch: when VIX is LOW, risk-on capital flows freely and momentum's favorable-skew premium holds; when VIX SPIKES, cross-asset deleveraging turns trend-following into a crash-prone bleed. This gates a crypto momentum LONG by the EQUITY vol regime — an orthogonal, cross-market regime read that the crypto-native dvol-calm-regime-momentum spec does NOT use (DVOL is crypto options; VIX is the equity fear gauge and leads cross-asset risk-off). Mechanism before data: long spot when crypto ret is positive AND vix_level sits below a fitted calm ceiling; exit when momentum fades or VIX spikes through an exit level (regime broke). Distinct from dvol-calm-regime-momentum (crypto DVOL gate), nasdaq-risk-appetite-leadlag-momentum (NDX price-direction, not vol-regime), and vol-regime-gated-momentum (own realized vol, not implied equity vol). Disconfirmer 1: drop the VIX gate — if bare crypto momentum matches the deflated Sharpe, the equity-vol regime adds nothing. Disconfirmer 2: VIX and crypto realized vol are correlated; if substituting vol_realized for vix_level does as well, the cross-market read is redundant with the existing realized-vol gate. Disconfirmer 3 (PIT/cost): VIX is daily next-day-available (FRED); net of ~20bps the gated momentum must clear. tier0 vix_level + tier0 ret_Nd, fresh-enough prod data, unproven combination — low-confidence until OOS.
catalyst: positive crypto momentum WHILE equity-implied vol (VIX) is in a calm regime — momentum's friendly cross-market weather
